verses.t: Kalata iyi yachokera kwa Paulo, mtumwa wa Khristu Yesu, amene Mulungu anamsankha kukhala mtumwi, natumizidwa kulalikira uthenga wabwino wake.
Mulungu analonjeza uthenga wabwino uwu kale kupyolera kwa aneneri ake mu Malemba oyera.
Uthenga wabwino ukhudza Mwana wake. Mwa moyo wake wa padziko lapansi, anabadwa m'banja la Mfumu Davide,
naonetsereka kukhala Mwana wa Mulungu ndi mphamvu, pamene anaukitsidwa kwa akufa ndi mphamvu ya Mzimu Woyera. Ndiye Yesu Khristu Ambuye wathu.

Kupyolera mwa Khristu, Mulungu anatipasa mwayi ndi ulamuliro monga atumwi, kuti tiziwuza anthu a mitundu yonse zimene Mulungu wachita kwa iwo, kuti akhulupirire namugonjere, nkudzetsa ulemu dzina lake.
Ndipo inunso muli mwa iwo amene anaitanidwa kukhala a Yesu Khristu.
Ndikuwalembera inu nonse ku Roma amene Mulungu amakukondani ndi amene anaitanidwa kukhala anthu ake oyera. Mulungu Atate wathu ndi Ambuye Yesu Khristu akupatseni chisomo ndi mtendere.
Choyamba, ndiyamikira Mulungu wanga kupyolera mwa Yesu Khristu chifukwa cha inu nonse, pakuti chikhulupiriro chanu chikudziwika padziko lonse lapansi.

Mulungu akudziwa mmene ndimapemphera chifukwa cha inu usana ndi usiku, ndimabweretsa inu ndi zosowa zanu m'pemphero kwa Mulungu, amene ndimtumikira ndi mtima wanga wonse polalikira uthenga wabwino wa Mwana wake.
Chimodzi mwa zinthu zimene nthawi zonse ndimapemphera ndichakuti, ngati Mulungu afuna, ndipeze mwayi wotsalira kubwera kukuwonani.
Pakuti ndikukhumbira kwambiri kukuonani, kuti ndikupatseni mphatso ina ya mzimu imene idzakukulimbitsani mu Ambuye.
Tikadzasonkhana, ndikufuna tidzilimbikizane mu chikhulupiriro chathu, ine ndi inu.

Ndikufuna mudziwe, abale anga okondedwa, kuti ndinaganiza nthawi zambiri za kubwera kukuonani, koma ndanalephereka mpaka lero. Ndikufuna kugwira ntchito pakati panu naona zipatso za mzimu, monga mmene ndaona pakati pa anthu a mitundu ina.
Ndili ndi ngongole kwa anthu onse, ophunzira ndi aophunzira, anzeru ndi aanzeru.
Chifukwa chake ndiri wokonzeka kulalikira uthenga wabwino kwa inu okhala ku Roma nawo.
Sindichita manyazi chifukwa cha uthenga wabwino wa Khristu. Ndi mphamvu ya Mulungu yopulumutsa aliyense amene akhulupirira, aYuda choyamba ndipo Agalaya nawo.

Pakuti uthenga wabwino uwonetsa mmene Mulungu atipatsa chilungamo pamaso pake. Izi zimachitika kuchokera ku chikhulupiriro mpaka ku chikhulupiriro. Monga Malemba amanena, "Wolungama adzakhala ndi moyo chifukwa cha chikhulupiriro."
Koma mkwiyo wa Mulungu ukuonetsereka kuchokera kumwamba pa anthu onse achimvi ndi oipa amene amakandamira chowona ndi zoipa zawo.
Pakuti zimene zingadziwirike za Mulungu zikuonekera kwa iwo, chifukwa Mulungu mwini anaziwonetsa.
Kuchokera pachiyambi cha dziko lapansi, zinthu zake zosawonekera, mphamvu yake ya muyaya ndi umulungu wake, zimawonekera bwino mwa zinthu zimene anapanga. Chifukwa chake anthu alibe chiphaso.
Pakuti ngakhale anam'dziwa Mulungu, sanafune kumtamanda monga Mulungu kapena kumuyamikira. M'malo mwake, maganizo awo anakhala achabe, ndipo mitima yawo yodima inakhala yosazindikira.
Anadzitcha anzeru, koma anakhala akhosi.
M'malo mwa kutamanda Mulungu waulemerero wamoyo, anapembedza mafano opangidwa kufanana ndi anthu opsa, mbalame, nyama ndi zokwawa.
Chifukwa chake Mulungu anawapereka kuti azichitire zinthu zonyansa zimene mitima yawo inali nazo. Anachitirana zonyansa ndi matupi awo.
Anasintha chowona cha Mulungu ndi bodza. Anapembedza nasumbirira zopangidwa m'malo mwa Mlengi, amene ayenera kutamandidwa kwamuyaya. Amen.
Ndi chifukwa chake Mulungu anawapereka ku zilakolako zawo zonyansa. Akazi anatembenuka motsutsana ndi mgwirizano wachikhalidwe, nachita mgwirizano wosiyana ndi chilengedwe chao.
Amuna momwemonso anasiya mgwirizano wachikhalidwe ndi akazi, napalira zilakolako zoipa wina kwa mnzake. Amuna anachitirana zonyansa, napindula m'thupi lawo ndi mlipiro wa kusamvera kwawo.
Popeza sankafunira kumudziwa Mulungu, Mulungu anawapereka ku maganizo awo achabe, kuchita zinthu zimene siziyenera.
Anadzazidwa ndi zoipa zonse, khalidwe lachigololo, chinyengo, chuma chochita zoipa, dumbu, nsanje, kupha, mikangano, chinyengo, khalidwe loyipa ndi mwano.
Ndi oneneza anthu m'mbuyo, adani a Mulungu, odzukulu, onyada ndi odzikuza. Apanga njira zatsopano za machimo, nasakaza makolo awo.
Opanda nzeru, opanga malonjezo awo okha, opanda chikondi ndi opanda chifundo.
Iwo akudziwa chiweruzo cha Mulungu chakuti ochita izi ayenera kufa, komabe akuzichitirabe ndipo akukondwera nawo ena achite chimodzimodzi.
Chifukwa chake, iwe woweruza aliyense, ulibe chiphaso. Pakuti pokawera wina, ukudziwereruza iwe wekha, popeza iwe amene ukuweruzira umachita zimodzimodzi.
Ndipo tidziwa kuti chiweruzo cha Mulungu chili cholungama pa amene achita izi.
Kodi uganiza kuti iwe, woweruza ena chifukwa cha kuchita izi, udzapewa chiweruzo cha Mulungu ukachita iwe mwini zimodzimodzi?
Kapena ukuona pang'ono kukoma mtima kwa Mulungu, chipiriro chake ndi kudzikhalira kwake? Kodi sudziwa kuti kukoma mtima kwake kukufuna utembenuke mtima?
Koma chifukwa cha kuuma mtima kwako ndi kukana kutembenuka, ukungogromba chilango choopsa pa iwe wekha. Pakuti tsiku la mkwiyo likubwera, pamene chiweruzo cholungama cha Mulungu chidzaonetsereka.
Iye adzaweruzira aliyense malinga ndi zimene wachita.
Adzapatsa moyo wosatha kwa amene akupitiriza kuchita zabwino, nafunafuna ulemerero, ulemu ndi kusatha.
Koma adzakhuthulira mkwiyo wake ndi ukali wake pa amene amagwira nkhondo ya dziko lawo, akukana chowona nakukhala m'zoipa.
Masautso ndi chisautso chidzakhala pa aliyense wochita zoipa, aYuda choyamba ndipo Agalaya nawo.
Koma ulemerero ndi ulemu ndi mtendere uchokera kwa Mulungu kwa aliyense wochita zabwino, aYuda choyamba ndipo Agalaya nawo.
Pakuti Mulungu savomereza mitu.
Onse amene anachimwa opanda malamulo adzawonongeka opanda malamulo; ndipo onse amene anachimwa ali ndi malamulo adzaweruzidwa ndi malamulo.
Pakuti kumvera malamulo wokha sikukwanira pamaso pa Mulungu. Ndi otsata malamulo amene adzakhala olungama.
Ngakhale Agalaya amene alibe malamulo a Mulungu olembedwa, akachitapo malamulo mwachikhalidwe, iwo okha ali malamulo okha.
Awonetsa kuti malamulo a Mulungu alemba m'mitima yawo, chikumbumtima chawo chikuchigwirizana, maganizo awo akewo akuwaweruzira kapena kuwalengeza.
Izi zidzaonekera pa tsiku pamene Mulungu, kupyolera mwa Khristu Yesu, adzaweruzire zinthu zachinsinsi za anthu, monga umene ndikulalikira.
Koma iwe umadzitcha Myuda, ukuonetsa kuti ukhulupirira malamulo a Mulungu, nakudzisangalaza chifukwa cha ubale wako ndi Mulungu.
Udziwa chifuno chake; ukamuza chomwe ndi chabwino, chifukwa waphunzitsidwa malamulo ake.
Ukhulupirira kuti ndiwe wotsogolera akhungu, kuwala kwa amene ali m'mdima.
Mphunzitsi wa aopusa, mphunzitsi wa ana, pakuti ukhulupirira kuti malamulo akukupatsa chidziwitso chathunthu cha chowona.
Kodi iwe wophunzitsa ena, sukudziphunzitsa iwe wekha? Ulalikira kuti anthu asabe, kodi iwe umaseba?
Umanena kuti usachite chigololo, kodi umachita chigololo? Ukanyoza mafano, kodi umalandira mphatso zakuba m'miko ya mafano?
Ukudzisangalaza ndi malamulo, koma ukupweteka Mulungu pokhatula malamulo amenewo.
Monga Malemba amanena, "Dzina la Mulungu limatukwanidwa pakati pa Agalaya chifukwa cha inu."
Mdulidwe uli ndi phindu ngati utsata malamulo. Koma ukakatula malamulo, mdulidwe wako ukukhala ngati wopanda mdulidwe.
Ndipo wopanda mdulidwe akasunga zofunikira za malamulo, kodi sadzawerengeredwa monga wolowa mdulidwe?
Ndipo amene sanakhale ndi mdulidwe mwachikhalidwe, akakwaniritsa malamulo, adzakuweruza iwe amene uli ndi lembo la malamulo ndi mdulidwe koma ukukatula malamulo.
Pakuti si Myuda weniweni amene wooneka mwa thupi; si mdulidwe weniweni umene wooneka mwa thupi.
Koma Myuda weniweni ndi amene ali Myuda mkati, ndipo mdulidwe weniweni ndi wa mtima, wa Mzimu osati wa lembo. Munthu ngati uyu amapeza matamando kwa Mulungu, osati kwa anthu.
Chotero, kodi pali phindu la kukhala Myuda? Kapena kodi mdulidwe uli ndi ntchito?
Inde, pali zambiri! Choyamba, aYuda analonjezedwa mawu a Mulungu.
Koma ngati ena sanakhulupirire, kodi kusakhulupirira kwawo kudzapangitsa Mulungu akhale wosakhulupirira?
Nayi! Mulungu akhale woona, ngakhale munthu aliyense akhale wabodza. Monga Malemba amanena, "Udzaonekera wolungama m'mawu ako, upambanso mukaweruzidwa."
Koma ngati kusalungama kwathu kukuwonetsa chilungamo cha Mulungu, tiyenera kunena chiyani? Kodi Mulungu ndi wosalungama pokhuthulira mkwiyo? (Ndikuyankhula monga anthu.)
Nayi! Ngati chotero, Mulungu angayendera bwanji dziko lapansi?
Koma ngati chowona cha Mulungu chinakula kupyolera kubodziwa kwanga, namupatsa ulemerero, ndi chifukwa chiyani ine ndiweruzidwa monga wochimwa?
Kodi tichita zoipa kuti zobwino zitiye? Monga amatineneza ena, tikumanena kotero. Chiweruzo cha anthu ngati awa ndi cholungama.
Chotero, tili abwino kuposa ena? Nayi, ndi konse konse, pakuti taonesha kale kuti aYuda ndi Agalaya onse ali pansi pa mphamvu ya tchimo.
Monga Malemba amanena, "Palibe wolungama, ngakhale mmodzi.
Palibe wozindikira; palibe wofunafuna Mulungu.
Onse anatembenuka; onse anakhala opanda pake. Palibe wochita zabwino, ngakhale mmodzi."
"Miphuno yawo ndi yofowula ngati manda otsegulidwa. Malilime awo amanyenga." "Mphute ya njoka ili pansi pa milomo yawo."
"Pakamwa pawo padzazidwa ndi matemberero ndi tsautso."
"Mapazi awo amadzamuka kukapha.
Chiwonongeko ndi chisautso zimatsatira njira zawo.
Njira ya mtendere saizindikira."
"Mantha a Mulungu alibe pamaso pawo."
Tidziwa kuti malamulo amalankhula kwa amene ali pansi pake, kuti pakamwa lonse liphekedwe ndi dziko lonse lizindikire kuti lili m'mlandu pamaso pa Mulungu.
Chifukwa chake palibe amene adzakhala wolungama pamaso pake ndi ntchito za malamulo; malamulo amaoneseratu tchimo.
Koma tsopano chilungamo cha Mulungu chaonetsereka, chosiyana ndi malamulo, chimene Malemba a Mose ndi aneneri anachibvomera.
Chilungamo cha Mulungu chimachita ntchito kupyolera chikhulupiriro mwa Yesu Khristu kwa onse amene akhulupirira. Palibe kusiyana.
Pakuti onse anachimwa, nafika pang'ono pa ulemerero wa Mulungu.
Ndipo amatsatsulidwa pa ufulu mwachisomo chake, kupyolera chipulumutso chimene chili mwa Khristu Yesu.

Mulungu anamuika Khristu kukhala nsembe ya chiyanjano kupyolera chikhulupiriro m'mwazi wake. Anachita izi kuwonetsa chilungamo chake, popeza anasagwira milandu ya machimo amene anachitidwa kale mu chipiriro chake.
Anachita izi kuwonetsa chilungamo chake pa nthawi iyi, kuti akhale wolungama ndi wochititsanso wolungama amene akhulupirira mwa Yesu.
Chotero kudzisangalaza kuli kuti? Kuchotheka. Ndi lamulo liti, la ntchito? Nayi, koma ndi lamulo la chikhulupiriro.
Pakuti tikhulupirira kuti munthu amatsatsulidwa ndi chikhulupiriro popanda ntchito za malamulo.
Kodi Mulungu ndi Mulungu wa aYuda okha? Kodi si Mulungu wa Agalaya nawo? Inde, ndi Mulungu wa Agalaya nawo.
Pali Mulungu mmodzi, amene adzatsatsulidwa ndi Myuda wamdulidwe ndi chikhulupiriro ndi wopanda mdulidwe nawo kupyolera chikhulupiriro chimodzimodzi.
Chotero tikupyola malamulo ndi chikhulupiriro? Nayi, ndi konse konse! Timakhazikitsa malamulo.
Chotero, tinganene chiyani za Abrahamu, kholo lathu la thupi?
Ngati Abrahamu anatsatsulidwa ndi ntchito, ali ndi chifukwa chodzisangalaza. Koma si pamaso pa Mulungu.
Pakuti Malemba amanena chiyani? "Abrahamu anakhulupirira Mulungu, ndipo chikhulupiriro chake chinawerengedwa kukhala chilungamo."
Kwa amene agwira ntchito, malipiro sawerengedwa monga chisomo, koma monga chifukwa.
Koma kwa amene sagwira ntchito koma akhulupirira amene amatsatsulidwa ochimwa, chikhulupiriro chake chimawerengeredwa kukhala chilungamo.
Monga mmene Davide ananenera mafana a munthu amene Mulungu amuwerengerera chilungamo popanda ntchito:
"Odala amene machimo awo aakhululukidwa, amene machimo awo afunikirira.
Wodala munthu amene Yehova sadzamuwerengereza tchimo."
Kodi madalitso awa ndi a amene analowa mdulidwe okha, kapena ndi a amene sanalowe mdulidwe nawo? Pakuti timanena, "Chikhulupiriro cha Abrahamu chinawerengedwa kukhala chilungamo."
Kodi chinawerengedwa liti? Analowa mdulidwe asanachitepo, kapena atalowe mdulidwe? Sinalowe mdulidwe, koma asanachitepo!

Analowa mdulidwe monga chizindikiro, kutsimikizira chilungamo cha chikhulupiriro chimene anali nacho asanalowe mdulidwe, kuti akhale atate wa onse akhulupirirayo opanda mdulidwe, kuti nawo awerengeredwe olungama.
Ndipo akhale atate wa amene analowa mdulidwe, osati chifukwa cha mdulidwe wokha, koma chifukwa amatsatira chikhulupiriro chimene atate wathu Abrahamu anali nacho asanalowe mdulidwe.
Pakuti lonjezo kwa Abrahamu kapena zidzukulu zake kuti adzalandira dziko lonse lapansi sinachokera pa malamulo, koma ndi chilungamo cha chikhulupiriro.
Pakuti amene akutenga gawo lawo ndi amene atsata malamulo, chikhulupiriro chakhala chopanda ntchito ndi lonjezo lawotha.
Pakuti malamulo amabweretsa mkwiyo, koma kumene kulibe malamulo, kulibeso kuphwanya.

Ndi chifukwa chake lonjezo limachokera pa chikhulupiriro, kuti likhale mwa chisomo, kutsimikizika kwa zidzukulu zonse, osati kwa amene ali ndi malamulo okha, koma nawo amene ali ndi chikhulupiriro cha Abrahamu. Ndi atate wathu onse ife,
monga Malemba amanena, "Ndakupanga atate wa mitundu yambiri," pamaso pa Mulungu amene anam'khulupirira, amene amapatsa akufa moyo nawapanga zinthu zosalipo kukhala zilipo.
Yenera kuyembekezerera, Abrahamu anakhulupirira ndi chiyembekezo, kuti akhale "atate wa mitundu yambiri," malinga ndi zimene zinanena, "Chotero zidzukulu zako zidzakhala."
Chikhulupiriro chake sichinafooka pamene anaona thupi lake, lazaka zokwana magana, ndi chiberekero cha Sara, chimene chauma.
Anagwezeukabe kusakhulupirira lonjezo la Mulungu, koma analimbika m'chikhulupiriro, napatsa ulemerero Mulungu.
Nakhala ndi chikhulupiriro chonse kuti Mulungu amatha kukwaniritsa zimene analonjeza.
Chifukwa chake chinawerengedwa kwa iye kukhala chilungamo.
Koma mawu akuti "chinawerengedwa kwa iye" sinalembedwa chifukwa cha iye yekha,
koma chifukwa cha ife nawo, amene chilungamo chidzawerengeredwa, takhulupirira amene anaukitsa Yesu Ambuye wathu kwa akufa.
Amene anaperekedwa chifukwa cha machimo athu, naaukitsidwa chifukwa cha kulungamitsidwa kwathu.
Chifukwa chake, tsatsulidwa ndi chikhulupiriro, tili ndi mtendere ndi Mulungu kupyolera Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu.
Kupyolera iye tinakhala ndi mwayi wa kulowa mu chisomo ichi chimene tikukhala mwake, ndipo tikudzisangalala m'chiyembekezo cha ulemerero wa Mulungu.
Kuposa apo, timadzidzisangalala nawo m'masautso athu, chifukwa tidziwa kuti masautso amabweretsa kupirira.
Ndipo kupirira kubweretsa khalidwe; khalidwe libweretsa chiyembekezo.
Ndipo chiyembekezo sichitipengetsa ku manyazi, pakuti chikondi cha Mulungu chathiriridwa m'mitima yathu ndi Mzimu Woyera amene watipatsa.
Pakuti tikanali ofooka, pa nthawi yoyenera, Khristu anafera achimwa.
Pakuti pang'ono kwambiri kuti munthu aferere wolungama, ngakhale wina akukhala ndi kulimba mtima kuferere wabwino.
Koma Mulungu wonetsa chikondi chake kwa ife, kuti Khristu anafera ife ife tikanali ochimwa.
Tsopano tatsulutsidwa ndi mwazi wake, tidzapulumutsidwa ndi iye ku mkwiyo wa Mulungu.
Pakuti ngati tinagwirizana ndi Mulungu kudza ndi imfa ya Mwana wake ife tikanali adani ake, koposa apo tizapulumutsidwa ndi moyo wake.
Kuposa apo, tikudzisangalala mwa Mulungu kupyolera Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu, amene kupyolera iye talandira kugwirizana.
Chifukwa chake, monga mmene tchimo linalowa padziko lapansi kupyolera munthu mmodzi, ndi imfa kupyolera tchimo, momwemonso imfa inakwanikira anthu onse, chifukwa onse anachimwa.
Pakuti tcomo linali m'dziko lapansi asananapange malamulo, koma tchimo siliwerengedwa kulibe malamulo.
Komabe imfa inalamulira kuchokera ku Adamu mpaka Mose, ngakhale amene sanachimwe mofanana ndi kuphwanya kwa Adamu, amene anali chizindikiro cha amene anali kubwera.

Koma mphatso yaulere sikufanana ndi kuphwanya. Pakuti ngati ambiri anamwalira chifukwa cha kuphwanya kwa mmodzi, Adamu, koposa apo chisomo cha Mulungu ndi mphatso mwa chisomo cha munthu mmodzi, Yesu Khristu, chinachulukira kwa ambiri.

Ndipo mphatso yaulere si monga zimene zinachitika kupyolera mmodzi wakuchimwa. Pakuti chiweruzo chinachokera pa mmodzi kukabweretsa chilango, koma mphatso yaulere yachokera pa machimo ambiri kukabweretsa chilungamo.

Pakuti imfa inalamulira kupyolera mmodzi chifukwa cha kuphwanya kwa mmodzi, koposa apo amene alandira chisomo chochulukira ndi mphatso ya chilungamo adzalamulira m'moyo kupyolera mmodzi, Yesu Khristu.
Chifukwa chake, monga kupyolera kuphwanya kwa mmodzi anthu onse anapezeka m'mlandu, momwemonso kupyolera ntchito yolungama ya mmodzi anthu onse adzapezeka olungama ndi moyo.
Pakuti monga kupyolera kusakamvera kwa mmodzi ambiri anakhala ochimwa, momwemonso kupyolera kumvera kwa mmodzi ambiri adzakhala olungama.
Malamulo analowa kuti kuphwanya kukule; koma kumene tchimo linakula, chisomo linachulukira koposa.
Kuti monga tchimo linalamulira m'imfa, momwemonso chisomo chilamulire kupyolera chilungamo ku moyo wosatha kupyolera Yesu Khristu Ambuye wathu.
Chotero tinganene chiyani? Tipitirire kuchimwa kuti chisomo chichulukire?
Nayi, ndi konse konse! Ife tafera tchimo, tingakhala bwanji tichimira molamu?
Kapena mukudziwa kuti ife onse tabatizidwa mwa Khristu Yesu tabatizidwa m'imfa yake?
Taikidwa pamodzi naye m'imfa yake m'ubatizo, kuti monga Khristu anaukitsidwa kwa akufa ndi ulemerero wa Atate, momwemonso nafe tiyende m'moyo watsopano.
Pakuti ngati tafatana naye m'imfa yake mofanana, ndithu tidzafatananso m'kuuka kwake.
Tidziwa izi, kuti munthu wathu wakale anapirikizidwa pamodzi ndi Khristu kuti thupi la tchimo liphethwe, kuti tisakhalire akapolo a tchimo.
Pakuti amene anafera wamasulutsidwa ku tchimo.
Koma ngati tafa pamodzi ndi Khristu, tikhulupirira kuti tidzakhalananso naye moyo.
Tidziwa kuti Khristu, anauka kwa akufa, sadzafaranso. Imfa ilibe lamuliro pa iye.
Pakuti imfa inachita nayi, anafera kwimodzi chabe ku tchimo; koma moyo umene akukhala ndi moyo, akukhala kwa Mulungu.
Momwemonso inunso mudziuzirani kuti muli akufa ku tchimo koma amoyo kwa Mulungu mwa Khristu Yesu.
Chifukwa chake musalolere tchimo kulamulira m'matupi anu opsereza, ndi kumvera zilakolako zake.

Musamapereke zangwe za matupi anu kwa tchimo kukhala zida za kusalungama; koma mdzipereke kwa Mulungu monga anthu akhala moyo uchokera ku imfa, ndi zangwe za matupi anu kwa Mulungu kukhala zida za chilungamo.
Pakuti tchimo silidzakulamulirani, pakuti simukhala pansi pa malamulo koma pansi pa chisomo.
Chotero tinganene chiyani? Tichimwe pakuti sitikhala pansi pa malamulo koma pansi pa chisomo? Nayi, ndi konse konse!
Mukudziwa kuti ngati mudzipereka kwa wina kukhala akapolo wogonjera, ndinu akapolo wake amene mumugonjera, kaya tchimo ku imfa, kaya kumvera ku chilungamo?
Koma tiyamike Mulungu, kuti munali akapolo a tchimo, koma munagona ndi mtima wonse ku mfano wa phunziro amene munaperekedwa nawo.
Namasulutsidwa ku tchimo, mukhala akapolo a chilungamo.

Ndikulankhula ndi fanizo la anthu chifukwa cha kufooka kwa matupi anu. Monga mupereka zangwe za matupi anu kukhala akapolo a kusaonala ndi zosalungama ku kuchimwa, momwemonso tsopano mupereke zangwe za matupi anu kukhala akapolo a chilungamo ku kukhala oyera.
Pakuti munali akapolo a tchimo, munali olufutu ku chilungamo.
Ndipo munapeza phindu lanji pa zinthu zimene tsopano mumachita manyazi nazo? Mapeto azo ndi imfa.
Koma tsopano, masulutsidwa ku tchimo namukhala akapolo wa Mulungu, mupeza zipatso zanu ku kukhala oyera, ndipo mapeto ake ndi moyo wosatha.
Pakuti malipiro a tchimo ndi imfa; koma mphatso yaulere ya Mulungu ndi moyo wosatha mwa Khristu Yesu Ambuye wathu.
Abale anga, (ndikulankhula kwa amene akudziwa malamulo) kodi mukudziwa kuti malamulo amalamulira munthu moyo wake wonse?
Pakuti mkazi wokwatiwa amangidwa ndi mwamuna wake moyo wake wonse ndi malamulo. Koma mwamuna wake akafa, wamasulutsidwa ku malamulo a mwamuna.

Chifukwa chake ngati alipo mwamuna wake, ndipo akwatiwa ndi mwamuna wina, adzatchedwa mkazi wachigololo. Koma mwamuna wake akafa, wamasulutsidwa ku malamulo, kuti asakhale wachigololo akwatiwanso ndi mwamuna wina.
Chifukwa chake, abale anga, inunso munaferadi malamulo kupyolera thupi la Khristu, kuti mukhale ake amene anaukitsidwa kwa akufa, kuti tipatse zipatso kwa Mulungu.
Pakuti tikhalira m'thupi, zilakolako za machimo, zodetserewa ndi malamulo, zinagwira ntchito m'zangwe zethu kubweretsa zipatso ku imfa.
Koma tsopano tamasulutsidwa ku malamulo, tafera ku chimene chinatimanga, kuti titumikire m'njira yatsopano ya Mzimu osati njira yakale ya lembo.

Chotero tinganene chiyani? Kodi malamulo ndi a tchimo? Nayi, ndi konse konse! Koma sindingazindikire tchimo ngati kukhala tchimo kupatula kupyolera malamulo. Sindinganadziwa kukhumba ndi tchimo ngati malamulo sanati, "Usakhumbire."
Koma tchimo, ndi lamulo ili kukhala mwayi, linagwita mu ine mtundu wonse wa kukhumba. Palibe malamulo, tchimo likufa.
Ndinakhala moyo kudza ku nthawiyi popanda malamulo; koma lamulo linafika, tchimo linatsitsimuka.
Ndipo ine ndinafa. Ndipo lamulo, limene linali ku moyo, linapezeka kwa ine kukhala ku imfa.
Pakuti tchimo, litapeza mwayi kupyolera lamulo, lininamizira, nalipheranso ndi lamilo.
Chifukwa chake malamulo ndi oyera, ndi lamulo ndi loyera, ndi cholungama, ndi chabwino.

Chotero, chimene ndi chabwino, chinakhala imfa kwa ine? Nayi, ndi konse konse! Koma tchimo, kuti lizionetsere monga tchimo, linagwira ntchito zabwino kubweretsa imfa kwa ine, kuti tchimo likhale loposa muyeso wa tchimo kupyolera lamulo.
Pakuti tidziwa kuti malamulo ndi a mzimu, koma ine ndili wa thupi, ndithengedwa ndi tchimo.
Chifukwa sindimvetsetsa zomwe ndichita. Pakuti simunachita zimene ndikufuna, koma ndimachita zimene ndidana nazo.
Ndipo ngati ndimachita zimene sindikufuna, ndivomeleza kuti malamulo ndi abwino.
Koma tsopano si ine wachita izi, koma tchimo lokhala mwa ine.
Pakuti ndidziwa kuti palibe chabwino lokhala mwa ine, mwa thupi langa la tchimo. Chifukwa ndili ndi chifuno cha chita chabwino, koma sichikuchepa kwanga.
Pakuti siundachite chabwino chimene ndikufuna, koma choyipa chimene sindikufuna ndicho ndimachita.
Koma ngati ndimachita zimene sindikufuna, si ine wachita izi, koma tchimo lokhala mwa ine.
Ndipo nzazindikira lamulo: pamene ndikufuna kuchita chabwino, choyipa chili pafupi.
Pakuti ndikondwera ndi malamulo a Mulungu m'munthu wamkati.
Koma ndiona lamulo lina m'zangwe zanga likulimbana ndi maganizo anga, nalimangira kapolo m'lamulo la tchimo lokhala m'zangwe zanga.
Ndine munthu wachisoni! Ndani adzandimasula ku thupi ino la imfa?
Tiyamike Mulungu kupyolera Yesu Khristu Ambuye wathu! Chifukwa chake, ine ndekha mwa maganizo anga nditumikira malamulo a Mulungu, koma mwa thupi la tchimo, malamulo a tchimo.
Chifukwa chake palibe chiweruzo tsopano kwa amene ali mwa Khristu Yesu.
Pakuti lamulo la Mzimu wa moyo mwa Khristu Yesu lanimasula ku lamulo la tchimo ndi imfa.

Pakuti zomwe zinalephereka kwa malamulo, popeza anali ofooka chifukwa cha thupi, Mulungu anachita: anatumiza Mwana wake m'chifaniziro cha thupi la tchimo, ndi chikhulupiriro cha tchimo, natsimikizira chiweruzo pa tchimo m'thupi.
Kuti chifunikiro cha chilungamo cha malamulo chikwaniritsidwe mwa ife, amene satiyenda monga thupi likufuna, koma monga Mzimu ukufuna.
Pakuti amene ali m'thupi amaganizira za thupi; koma amene ali m'Mzimu amaganizira za Mzimu.
Pakuti kuganizira kwa thupi ndi imfa; koma kuganizira kwa Mzimu ndi moyo ndi mtendere.
Chifukwa cha ichi kuganizira kwa thupi ndi udani ndi Mulungu; pakuti sikugona pansi pa malamulo a Mulungu, ndipo nkhope sichithe.
Ndipo amene ali m'thupi santhupe kukondweretsa Mulungu.
Koma inu si m'thupi, koma m'Mzimu, ngati Mzimu wa Mulungu akukhala mwa inu. Koma ngati wina alibe Mzimu wa Khristu, iye ndi wake.
Koma ngati Khristu ali mwa inu, thupi ndi lafa chifukwa cha tchimo, koma Mzimu ndi moyo chifukwa cha chilungamo.
Koma ngati Mzimu wa amene anaukitsa Yesu kwa akufa akukhala mwa inu, iye amene anaukitsa Khristu kwa akufa adzapatsa moyo nawo matupi anu opsereza kupyolera Mzimu wake wokhala mwa inu.
Chifukwa chake, abale, tili ndi ngongole, osati kwa thupi kukhala m'moyo monga thupi likufuna.
Pakuti mukhala m'moyo monga thupi likufuna, mudzafa; koma mukapha ntchito za thupi ndi Mzimu, mudzakhala ndi moyo.
Pakuti onse atsogoleredwa ndi Mzimu wa Mulungu, iwo ndi ana a Mulungu.
Pakuti simulandira Mzimu wa ukapolo kubwezera ku mantha; koma mulandira Mzimu wa kulandidwa kukhala ana, amene mwa iye timaitana, "Abba, Atate."
Mzimu mwini umavomerereza mzimu wathu kuti tili ana a Mulungu.
Ndipo ngati tili ana, tili olowa nawo; olowa a Mulungu, ndi olowa pamodzi ndi Khristu; ngati tikumana nawo m'masautso, kuti tidzalandira nawo m'ulemerero.
Pakuti ndikhulupirira kuti masautso a nthawi ino sakuyenera kufananizidwa ndi ulemerero umene udzaululurwe kwa ife.
Pakuti chilengedwe chikudikirira ndi mafupi kuululurwa kwa ana a Mulungu.
Pakuti chilengedwe chinagonjezedwa ku chopanda ntchito, osati mwaufupi wake, koma chifukwa cha amene anagonjeza, ndi chiyembekezo
kuti chilengedwe chidzasulutsidwanso ku ukapolo wa kusea ku ufulu wa ulemerero wa ana a Mulungu.
Pakuti tidziwa kuti chilengedwe chonse chikulira pamodzi ndi kuzunzika pamodzi mpaka lero.
Ndipo osati iwo okha, koma naife amene tali ndi zipatso za Mzimu, timali m'mtima mwathu tikulira tikudikirira kulandidwa kukhala ana, kupulumuka kwa matupi athu.
Pakuti tapulumutsidwa m'chiyembekezo. Koma chiyembekezo chimene chinaoneka sichiyembekezo. Pakuti amene anaona chiyani angayembekezerere?
Koma ngati tiyembekezerera chimene sitinaone, tikudikirira ndi kupirira.
Momwemonso Mzimu umathandiza ufowu wathu. Pakuti sitidziwa kuchita pemphero monga tiyenera; koma Mzimu mwini umapemphera chifukwa chathu ndi kufulumira kumene sikudziwika mwa mawu.
Ndipo iye waphunzira mitima akudziwa maganizo a Mzimu, kuti amapempherera oyera malinga ndi Mulungu.
Ndipo tidziwa kuti Mulungu amachitisa zonse ntchito pamodzi kwa abwino kwa amene amam'konda Mulungu, kwa amene anaitanidwa malinga ndi zolinga zake.
Pakuti iwo amene anadziwa kale, nawasankha kale kuti akhale ofanana ndi chifaniziro cha Mwana wake, kuti akhale woyamba mwa abale ambiri.
Ndipo iwo amene anasankha kale, anawaitana; ndi amene anawaitana, anawatsiritsa olungama; ndi amene anawatsiritsa olungama, anawapatsa ulemerero.
Chotero tinganene chiyani za izi? Ngati Mulungu ali kwa ife, ndani angatsiike?
Amene sanasunga Mwana wake yekha, koma anapereka iye chifukwa chathu tonse, angakhala asatipatse nawo zinthu zonse pamodzi naye bwanji?
Ndani adzayimbe mlandu a osankhidwa a Mulungu? Ndi Mulungu amene amatsitira olungama.
Ndani amene adzalange? Ndi Khristu Yesu amene anamwalira, koposa apo anaukitsidwa, ali kudzanja la Mulungu, akupemphera chifukwa chathu.
Ndani adzatisiire ku chikondi cha Khristu? Kodi masautso, kapena kusautsa, kapena kuzingidwa, kapena njala, kapena kutaya, kapena chiopsezo, kapena lupanga?
Monga Malemba amanena, "Chifukwa chako timaphedwa tsiku lonse; tiwerengedwa monga nkhosa zotemvedwa."
Ayi, m'zinthu zonse izi topambana ndi kupambanitsidwa kupyolera iye amene anatikonda.
Pakuti nditsimikizirika kuti imfa, kapena moyo, kapena angelo, kapena akuluakulu, kapena zinthu zilipo tsopano, kapena zinthu za m'tsogolo, kapena mphamvu,
kapena kukwera, kapena kutsika, kapena chilengedwe china chilichonse, sichidzathe kutipatukanitsira ku chikondi cha Mulungu, chimene chili mwa Khristu Yesu Ambuye wathu.
Ndinanena chowona mwa Khristu, sindibodza; chikumbumtima changa chinandikaika m'Mzimu Woyera,
kuti ndili ndi chisoni chachikulu ndi kulira kwa mtima kosatha.
Pakuti ndikanafunira kutembeleredwa ndekha, kudulidwa kwa Khristu, chifukwa cha abale anga monga thupi, aIsraeli.
Amene ndi aIsraeli, amene ndi kulandidwa kukhala ana, ndi ulemerero, ndi mapangano, ndi kupatsidwa malamulo, ndi utumiki, ndi malonjezo.
Amene makolo awo ndi iwo, ndipo Khristu monga thupi anachokera mwa iwo, amene ali Mulungu pa zinthu zonse, wotamandidwa kwamuyaya. Amen.
Koma sikuti mawu a Mulungu awalephera. Pakuti si onse ochokera ku Israeli ali Israeli weniweni.
Kapena akhale mbewu ya Abrahamu, onse ali ana ake; koma, "Mwa Isake zidzukulu zako zidzatchedwa."
Izi ndi izi: si ana a thupi ndi ana a Mulungu; koma ana a lonjezo ndi amene awerengedwa monga mbewu.
Pakuti mawu a lonjezo ndi awa: "Pa nthawi iyi ndidzabwera, ndipo Sara adzali ndi mwana."
Ndipo si iye yekha; koma Rebeka nawo ali ndi ana awiri ndi mwamuna mmodzi, Isake kholo lathu.
Pakuti asanabadwe, asanachite chabwino kapena choipa, kuti cholinga cha Mulungu mwa kusankha chikakhale,
osati ndi ntchito, koma ndi amene anaitana, anauziridwa, "Wamkulu adzatumikira wamng'ono."
Monga Malemba amanena, "Ndinakonda Yakobo, ndinana Esau."
Chotero tinganene chiyani? Kodi pali chosalungama mwa Mulungu? Nayi, ndi konse konse!
Pakuti Mulungu anauza Mose, "Ndidzachitira chifundo amene ndichitira chifundo, ndidzachitira chisoni amene ndichitira chisoni."
Chifukwa chake si cha amene akufuna kapena cha amene akuthamanga, koma cha Mulungu amene amachitira chifundo.
Pakuti Malemba amanena kwa Farao, "Chifukwa ichi ndinakuutsitsa, kuti ndionetse mphamvu yanga mwa iwe, ndipo dzina langa lilalalikizike m'dziko lonse lapansi."
Chifukwa chake amchitira chifundo amene akufuna, ndi waumiritsa amene akufuna.
Chotero unganenera kwa ine, "Ndi chifukwa chiyani akali ndi mlandu? Pakuti ndani wathana ndi chifuno chake?"
Iwe, munthu ndiwe ndani wotsutsana ndi Mulungu? Kodi mchitiko ungauze woichita, "Unindipanga chifukwa chiyani?"
Kapena mlengi wa nkhali walibe ufulu pa dothi, kumchitira mwa gawi limodzi nkhali imodzi yolemekezeka ndi inayo ya manyazi?
Ndipo ngati Mulungu, ndi kufuna kuonetsa mkwiyo wake ndi kuzindikira mphamvu yake, anakhala ndi chipiriro chachikulu pa ziwiya za mkwiyo zokonzedwa ku chiwonongeko?
Ndipo kuti azidziwitse chuma cha ulemerero wake pa ziwiya za chifundo, zimene anakonzera kale ku ulemerero?
Ngakhale ife amene anaitana, osati mwa aYuda chabe, koma mwa Agalaya nawo?
Monga amanena mwa Hosea nawo, "Ndidzaitana iye womwe sanali anthu anga, anthu anga; ndi iye womwe sanali wokondedwa, wokondedwa."
"Ndipo kudzachitika kumene kunauziridwa kwa iwo, inu si anthu anga, kumeneko adzatchedwa ana a Mulungu wamoyo."
Isaya akufuwulirira za Israeli, "Ngakhale kuchuluka kwa ana a Israeli kukhale ngati mchenga wa nyanja, wotsalira adzapulumutsidwa.
Pakuti Ambuye adzakwaniritsa ndi kuperewetsa mawu ake pa dziko lapansi."
Ndipo monga Isaya analonjeza kale, "Ambuye wa Mamphamvu angasatisiyire mbewu, tikanalikha Sodomu, tikufanana ndi Gomora."
Chotero tinganene chiyani? Kuti Agalaya amene sanatsatira chilungamo, anadzipeza chilungamo, chilungamo cha chikhulupiriro.
Koma Israeli anatsatira malamulo a chilungamo sanapeze malamulo.
Chifukwa chiyani? Chifukwa sanatsatire ndi chikhulupiriro, koma monga ndi ntchito. Anagwetsereka pa mwala wa kugwetsa.
Monga Malemba amanena, "Taona, ndikuyika mwa Ziyoni mwala wa kugwetsa ndi thanthwe la kugwedera; ndipo aliyense wakhulupirira mwa iye sadzachititsidwa manyazi."
Abale, chifuniro cha mtima wanga ndi pemphero langa kwa Mulungu la Israeli ndi kuti apulumutsidwe.
Pakuti ndikuwavomereza kuti ali ndi mfupi ya Mulungu, koma sililongosoka.
Pakuti, posazindikira chilungamo cha Mulungu, nafuna kukhazikitsa chawo chokha, sagonjera chilungamo cha Mulungu.
Pakuti Khristu ndi mapeto a malamulo ku chilungamo kwa aliyense wakhulupirira.
Pakuti Mose alemba kuti, munthu wochita chilungamo cha malamulo adzakhala ndi moyo mwa izo.
Koma chilungamo cha chikhulupiriro chimanena kotero, "Usanene m'mtima mwako, Ndani adzakwera kumwamba?" (ichi ndi kubweretsa Khristu pansi pano.)
"Kapena, Ndani adzatsika ku nchi yamawonekedwe?" (ichi ndi kubweretsa Khristu kwa akufa.)
Koma chimanena chiyani? "Mawu ali pafupi nawe, m'kamwa mwako ndi m'mtima mwako"; ichi ndi mawu a chikhulupiriro amene timalikira.
Pakuti ngati unena m'kamwa mwako kuti Yesu ndi Ambuye, ndi kukhulupirira m'mtima mwako kuti Mulungu anamuukitsa kwa akufa, upulumutsidwa.
Pakuti m'mtima kukhulupirira kumabweretsa chilungamo; ndi pakamwa kunena kumabweretsa chipulumutso.
Pakuti Malemba amanena, "Aliyense wakhulupirira mwa iye sadzachititsidwa manyazi."
Pakuti palibe kusiyana pakati pa Myuda ndi Mgalaya, pakuti Ambuye mmodzi ali Ambuye wa onse, napatsa mwaufulu onse amene amam'tcha.
"Pakuti aliyense wotcha dzina la Ambuye apulumutsidwa."
Koma angam'tche bwanji amene sanam'khulupirire? Ndi angamkhulupirire bwanji amene sanamvere? Ndi angamvire bwanji palibe walalikira?
Ndi angalalikire bwanji asatumizidwe? Monga Malemba amanena, "Mapazi a amene analalikira uthenga wabwino wa zabwino ndi okongola!"
Koma si onse anamvera uthenga wabwino. Pakuti Isaya anati, "Ambuye, ndani anakhulupirira uthenga wathu?"
Chifukwa chake chikhulupiriro chimabwera pa kumva, ndi kumva kumabwera ndi mawu a Khristu.
Koma ndifunsa, kodi sanamve? Ndithu, "Mawu awo anatuluka m'dziko lonse lapansi, ndi malankhulidwe awo kufikira kumapeto kwa dziko."
Koma ndifunsa, kodi Israeli sanadziwe? Choyamba Mose anati, "Ine ndidzakukukhalanitsani ndi mtundu wopanda chipatso; ndi mtundu wopanda nzeru ndidzakupsyerezani."
Ndipo Isaya analimba mtima kwambiri nanena, "Ndinapezeka ndi amene sanandifunafuna; ndionetsedwa ndi amene sanandifunsa."
Koma za Israeli anati, "Tsiku lonse ndinatambasulira manja anga kwa anthu osagona pansi ndi okaniza."
Ndifunsa chifukwa chake, kodi Mulungu anakana anthu ake? Nayi, ndi konse konse! Pakuti ine ndekha ndili Myuda, wa mbewu ya Abrahamu, wa fuko la Benjamini.
Mulungu sanakane anthu ake amene anadziwa kale. Kodi mukudziwa zimene Malemba amanena za Eliya, mmene anapemphera kwa Mulungu mosaolera Israeli, nanena,
"Ambuye, apheya aneneri ako, nagumula maguwa ako a nsembe; ndipo ine ndekha ndikhala, ndipo akufunafuna moyo wanga."
Koma yankhulo la Mulungu linati chiyani kwa iye? "Ndizisunga kwa ine mitu 7,000 ya amuna amene sanapinde mawondo kwa Baali."
Momwemonso nawo pa nthawi ino yalipo wotsalira mwa kusankha cha chisomo.
Koma ngati cha chisomo, si cha ntchito; mukacha, chisomo sichingakhale chisomo.
Chotero? Zimene Israeli akufunafuna, sanazipeze; koma osankhidwa anazipeza, ndipo ena anaumirika.
Monga Malemba amanena, "Mulungu anawapatsa mzimu wa tulo, maso osaona, makutu osamva, mpaka lero."
Ndipo Davide anati, "Bwalo lawo likhale nsekwe ndi ngosyo ndi chifukwa cha kugwetsa ndi chilipiro chawo.
Maso awo atime kuti asamaone, namsana wawo ugwede kwamuyaya."
Ndifunsa chifukwa chake, kodi anagwera kuti agwere? Nayi, ndi konse konse! Koma ndi kuphwanya kwawo chipulumutso chinafika kwa Agalaya, kuti awakhale ndi nsanje.
Ndipo ngati kuphwanya kwawo ndi chuma cha dziko lapansi, ndi kusalingana kwawo chuma cha Agalaya, koposa kwambiri kuti kuchulukika kwawo!
Pakuti ndikuyankhulira inu Agalaya. Chifukwa ndiri mtumwi wa Agalaya, ndilemeretsa utumiki wanga,
kuti mwa njira iliyonse ndizikhala ndi nsanje a anthu anga, ndipulumutse ena mwa iwo.
Pakuti ngati kutayidwa kwawo ndi kuyanjanitsidwa kwa dziko, kuchali kwawo kukhala chiyani, koma moyo kuchokera ku akufa?
Ngati mkate wa mazowe ndi woyera, mtanda nawo; ndipo ngati muzu ndi woyera, nthambi nazo.
Koma ngati nthambi zina zinaturidwa, ndipo iwe, ukhala mtengo wachifisi wamtchire, unkhutsizidwa pakati pawo, nakhala wenzi wa muzu ndi unapi wa mzaiti,
usadzisangalaze kwa nthambi. Koma ngati ukudzisangalaza, si iwe ukunyamula muzu, koma muzu ukukulimba.
Unganena, "Nthambi zinaturidwa kuti ine ndikhutsizidwe."
Chabwino; chifukwa cha kusakhulupirira zinatulidwa, koma iwe uima ndi chikhulupiriro. Usabe maganizo adzikuza, koma opa.
Pakuti ngati Mulungu sanasunga nthambi zamlendo, sanakusunga nawe.
Onani chifukwa chake kukoma mtima ndi mphamvu ya Mulungu; pa amene agwa, mphamvu; koma pa iwe kukoma mtima kwa Mulungu, ngati ukukhala m'kukoma mtima kwake; mukacha, nawe uturuka.
Ndipo nawo, ngati satrwala m'kusakhulupirira, adzakhutsiziridwa; pakuti Mulungu wamthu akhutsiziranso.

Pakuti ngati iwe unaturidwa kwa mzaiti wachikhalidwe wachifisi, nawe nakhutsizidwa posalongosoka m'mtengo wabwino wa mzaiti, koposa angasinthe ngati zoyenera amene ndi nthambi zamlendo zikhutsizidwa m'mtengo wawo wa mzaiti!

Pakuti sindifuna kuti inu mukhale opanda chidziwitso cha chinsinsi ichi, abale, kuti musabe anzeru pa maganizo anu; kuti kuuma mtima kunachitika pa gawo la Israeli mpaka chiwerengero chathunthu cha Agalaya chilowe.
Ndipo momwemonso Israeli yonse ipulumutsidwa; monga Malemba amanena, "Mpulumutsi adzabwera kuchokera ku Ziyoni; adzachotsa mofuna kwa Yakobo.
Ndipo ichi ndi pangano langa nawo, nditachotse machimo awo."
Monga uthenga wabwino ukukhudza, ndi adani chifukwa chanu; koma monga kusankha kukhudzidwa, ndi okondedwa chifukwa cha makolo awo.
Pakuti mphatso ndi kuitana kwa Mulungu si cha kumbukazumba.
Pakuti monga inunso munali opanda kumvera Mulungu kale, koma tsopano munapeza chifundo chifukwa cha kusapanda kumvera kwawo,
momwemonso nawo tsopano sanagone pansi, kuti nawo apeze chifundo kupyolera chifundo chimene chinachitiridwa inu.
Pakuti Mulungu anagonjeza onse m'kusapanda kumvera, kuti azichitiridwa chifundo onse.
Aa, nzika ndi chuma cha nzeru ndi chidziwitso cha Mulungu! Kusirika bwanji zisankho zake ndi njira zake zosagwiririka!
Pakuti ndani anadziwa maganizo a Ambuye? Kapena ndani anakhala mchenjezi wake?
Kapena ndani anamupatsa chiyamba kuti abwezeredwe?
Pakuti mwa iye, ndi kupyolera iye, ndi kwa iye zinthu zonse zili. Ulemerero wake kwamuyaya. Amen.
Chifukwa chake, ndikukupemphani, abale, ndi chifundo cha Mulungu, kuti mupereke matupi anu kukhala nsembe yamoyo, yoyera, yokondekera Mulungu, nchito yanu yokhulupirika.
Musamazifananize ndi dziko ino; koma sintherani ndi kusintha kwa maganizo, kuti musinthike ndi kudziwa chifuniro cha Mulungu, ndi chabwino ndi chokondeka ndi chathunthu.

Pakuti kupyolera chisomo chimene chinaperekedwa kwa ine, ndinena kwa aliyense pakati panu kuti akhale ndi maganizo opanda kuchuluka kuposa ayenera, koma akhale ndi maganizo ozama ndi kuyenera, malinga ndi muyeso wa chikhulupiriro amene Mulungu wapatsa aliyense.
Pakuti monga m'thupi limodzi tili ndi zangwe zambiri, ndipo zangwe zonse sizili ndi ntchito imodzi,
momwemonso ife ochuluka tili thupi limodzi mwa Khristu, ndipo zangwe za wina ndi zangwe za mnzake.
Ali ndi mphatso zosiyana malinga ndi chisomo chimene tapatsidwa: ngati chinenero cha mneneri, tichite malinga ndi muyeso wa chikhulupiriro;
kapena utumiki, m'kutumikira; kapena wophunzitsa, m'kuphunzitsa;
kapena wolimbikitsa, m'kulimbikitsa; wopereka, m'kuona mtima; wolongosora, m'kuyangala; woonetsa chifundo, m'chisangalalo.
Chikondi chikhale choona. Idanani choyipa; mangirirani chabwino.
M'chikondi cha ubale kondanani wina ndi mnzake ndi mtima. M'ulemu yanganirani kwa wina kuposa inu nokha.
Musakhale anzeru; m'kuyanga' anani mwa mfupi; mutumikire Ambuye.
Sangalalani m'chiyembekezo; khalani ndi chipiriro m'masautso; pitiririzani m'pemphero.
Thandizani m'zosowa za oyera; tsatsiranani kulandira alendo.
Dalitsani amene akukuzingidani, dalitsani osati kutemberera.
Sangalalani ndi amene asangalala, ndipo lirani ndi amene alira.
Khalani ndi maganizo amodzi m'wina ndi mnzake. Musabe maganizo adzikuza, koma khudzanani ndi otseka. Musamaona okha anzeru.
Musamabwezere wina woipa zoipa. Ganinizani zazabwino pamaso pa anthu onse.
Kukhali konse ndithu, khalani ndi mtendere ndi anthu onse.
Okondedwa, musabwezere nokha, koma mupatse njira ya mkwiyo wa Mulungu; pakuti Malemba amanena, "Kubwezera nkwanga; ndidzalipira," akuuza Ambuye.
Koma, "Mdani wako akalira njala, mchiliseni; akalira ludzu, mupatseni chakumwa; pakuti pochita izi udzamkumuduka miyala yoyaka moto mutu wake."
Musangangamuke ndi choyipa, koma pangamukani choyipa ndi chabwino.
Mzimu yense agone pansi pa akuluakulu oulamulira. Pakuti palibe ulamuliro kupatula kwa Mulungu, ndipo akuluakulu alipo akhazikitsidwa ndi Mulungu.
Chifukwa chake amene akutsutsa ulamuliro akutsutsa zimene Mulungu wakhazikitsa, ndipo amene akutsutsa adzalandira chiweruzo.
Pakuti akuluakulu si aopsa kwa ntchito yabwino, koma kwa yoipa. Kodi ukufuna kuopa ulamuliro? Chita chabwino, ndipo udzalandira chiyamiko chake.
Pakuti ndi mtumiki wa Mulungu kwa iwe ku chabwino. Koma ukuchita choipa, opa, pakuti sayang'ana lupanga pachabe. Ndi mtumiki wa Mulungu, wochita mkwiyo kulanga amene achita choipa.
Chifukwa chake kugona pansi ndi chofunikira, osati chifukwa cha mkwiyo wokha, koma chifukwa cha chikumbumtima nawo.
Chifukwa chache nawo mulipa msonkho, pakuti ndi atumiki a Mulungu, opitiriza m'izi chifuniro chake.
Patsa onse zimene mwagwera awo: msonkho kwa amene msonkho wali wake, chikho kwa amene chikho chili chake, mantha kwa amene mantha ali ake, ulemu kwa amene ulemu uli wake.
Musamakhale ndi ngongole ndi wina aliyense, kupatula kuzikhonda wina ndi mnzake; pakuti amene wakonda mnzake wakwaniritsa malamulo.
Pakuti, "Usachite chigololo, Usapha, Usabe, Usakhumbire"; ndipo ngati lamulo lina lili, lidzumiziridwa m'mawu awa: "Ukonde mzako ngati iwe nokha."
Chikondi sichichita choipa kwa mzako; chifukwa chake chikondi ndi kukwaniritsa kwa malamulo.
Izi, nakudziwa nthawi, kuti nthawi ya imfa yanu yafika; pakuti tsopano chipulumutso chili pafupi kwambiri nawo kuposa pamene tinakhulupirira choyamba.
Usiku watupa; usiku weniweni wafika pafupi. Chotero tiulule ntchito za mdima, tivalike zida za kuwala.
Tiyende momweniweni monga usiku, osati m'zibe ndi kolowera, osati m'chigololo ndi zonyansa, osati m'mikangano ndi nsanje.
Koma muvalike Ambuye Yesu Khristu, ndipo musachite kanthu kuchitira zilakolako za thupi.
Mulandiridwe amene ndi ofooka m'chikhulupiriro, koma osatsutse pankhani za maganizo.
Wina akhulupirira kulya zonse; koma amene ndi ofooka amadya ndiwo.
Amene akudya asazidere amene sadya; ndipo amene sadya asalange amene akudya, pakuti Mulungu wawalandira.
Iwe ndiwe ndani kulang'anira mtumiki wa mnzako? Kwa mbuye wake yekha alamira kapena agwa. Adzaimirizidwa, pakuti Ambuye ali ndi mphamvu yomisimikizira.
Wina ayesa tsiku kuposera linzake; mnzake ayesa tsiku lonse. Aliyense azitsimikizire nokha m'maganizo ake.
Amene ayankhula tsiku, ayankhula kwa Ambuye; ndi amene akudya, akudya kwa Ambuye, pakuti amayamika Mulungu; ndi amene sadya, sadya kwa Ambuye, nayamika Mulungu.
Pakuti palibe wa ife wakhala kwa iye yekha, ndipo palibe wakhala kwa iye yekha.
Pakuti ngati tikhala, tikhala kwa Ambuye; ndipo ngati tifa, tifa kwa Ambuye. Chifukwa chake takhala kapena tafa, tili ake Ambuye.
Pakuti Khristu naferadi ndi kuukadi kwa cholinga ichi, kuti akhale Ambuye wa akufa ndi amoyo.
Koma iwe, ndi chifukwa chiyani uweruzira mwini wako? Kapena iwe nawo, ndi chifukwa chiyani uzidere mwini wako? Pakuti tonse tidzayima pa mpando wa chiweruzo cha Mulungu.
Pakuti Malemba amanena, "Ndiri moyo, akuuza Ambuye, mawondo onse adzagwada kwa ine, ndipo malilime onse adzatamanda Mulungu."
Chifukwa chake aliyense mwa ife adzapereka ndemanga yawo yekha kwa Mulungu.
Chifukwa chake tisiyeni kulangana. Koma muganizire ichi: kusamayika chifukwa cha mwini wako kapena kugwetsa.
Ndidziwa ndi kutsimikiziridwa m'Ambuye Yesu kuti palibe chinthu choipitsidwa mwa chokha. Koma kwa amene akhulupirira kuti ndi choipa, kwa iye ndi choipa.
Pakuti ngati mwini wako wachititsidwa chisoni ndi chakudya chako, sukhala m'chikondi. Usamuwononge ndi chakudya chako amene Khristu anafera chifukwa chake.
Chifukwa chake musalole kuti chabwino chanu chitukwanidwe.
Pakuti Ufumu wa Mulungu si nkhani ya kudya ndi kumwa, koma chilungamo ndi mtendere ndi chimwemwe mwa Mzimu Woyera.
Pakuti amene atumikira Khristu m'zimenezi, anakondwetsa Mulungu ndi kulandiriridwa ndi anthu.
Chifukwa chake titsatire zinthu za mtendere ndi zinthu zolimbitsa wina ndi mnzake.
Usamuwononge ntchito ya Mulungu chifukwa cha chakudya. Ndithu, zinthu zonse ndi zoyera; koma choyipa kwa munthu amene akudya ndi kugwetsa.
Ndi chabwino kusadya nyama kapena kumwa vinyo, kapena kuchita chilichonse chimene mwini wako nagwera kapena achititsidwe utsi kapena fooka.
Chikhulupiriro chako, sikhali nacho pamaso pako ndi Mulungu? Wodala amene aziweruzira okha m'zimene avomera.
Koma amene akuyesa, ngati adya, aweruzidwa, pakuti si ndi chikhulupiriro; ndipo chilichonse chimene sichi ndi chikhulupiriro ndi tchimo.
Ife olimba tiyenera kunyamula mafowulo a ofooka, osatokota nokha.
Aliyense mwa ife akondwere mzake ku chabwino, kulimbitsa.
Pakuti Khristu sanakondwera nokha; koma monga Malemba amanena, "Kutukwana kwa amene akukunyoza kwagwa pa ine."
Pakuti zonse zimene zinalembedwa kale, zinalembedwa ku chiphunzitso chathu, kuti kupyolera kupirira ndi kulimbikitsidwa kwa Malemba tikhale ndi chiyembekezo.
Koma Mulungu wa kupirira ndi kulimbikitsa akupatseni kukhala ndi maganizo amodzi pakati panu, malinga ndi Khristu Yesu,
kuti ndi mtima umodzi ndi kamwa limodzi mutamande Mulungu Atate wa Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu.
Chifukwa chake mulandiraneni wina ndi mnzake, monga Khristu analandiranso ife, ku ulemerero wa Mulungu.
Pakuti ndinanena kuti Khristu anakhala mtumiki wa mdulidwe chifukwa cha chowona cha Mulungu, kuti atsimikizire malonjezo a makolo,
ndipo kuti Agalaya atalamanda Mulungu chifukwa cha chifundo chake; monga Malemba amanena, "Chifukwa chake ndidzakutamanda pakati pa amitundu, ndipo nditaimbirira dzina lako."
Ndipo kwa iye anati, "Sangalalani, amitundu, pamodzi ndi anthu ake."
Ndipo kwa iye, "Tamandani Ambuye, amitundu onse, ndipo mtamandeni, anthu onse."
Ndipo Isaya anati, "Padzakhala chidindo cha Yese, ndi wokwera kulamulira amitundu; mwa iye amitundu adzakhala ndi chiyembekezo."
Ndipo Mulungu wa chiyembekezo akudzaze ndi chimwemwe ndi mtendere wonse m'kukhulupirira, kuti muchulukire m'chiyembekezo ndi mphamvu ya Mzimu Woyera.
Ndipo ine mwini ndinesimikizirika, abale anga, kuti inunso ndi abwino odzaza, odzazidwa ndi chidziwitso chonse, oyenera kulimbikitsana wina ndi mnzake.
Koma ndinakuwalembera nthawi zina molimba mtima, ponena kwa inu monga pokumbutsira, chifukwa cha chisomo chimene Mulungu wandipatsa,
kukhala mtumiki wa Yesu Khristu kwa amitundu, ndikutumikira Uthenga wabwino wa Mulungu monga wansembe, kuti nsembe ya amitundu ikhale yolandiririka, yoyeretsedwa ndi Mzimu Woyera.
Chifukwa chake ndili ndi chifukwa chodzisangalaza mwa Khristu Yesu m'zinthu za Mulungu.
Pakuti sindilimba mtima kunena chilichonse kupatula zimene Khristu wachita kupyolera ine, ku kumvera kwa amitundu m'mawu ndi m'ntchito,
m'mphamvu ya zizindikiro ndi zodabwitsa, m'mphamvu ya Mzimu wa Mulungu; kotero kuti kuchokera ku Yerusalemu ndi kutsekemera paliponse ku Iliriku, ndalengeza uthenga wabwino wa Khristu.
Momwemonso ndinazichita ndi mfupi kulalikira uthenga wabwino kumene Khristu sanatchedwe, kuti ndisamange pa maziko a wina,
koma monga Malemba amanena, "Amene sanamuziwike adzaona, ndi amene sanamvere adzamvetsa."
Chifukwa chake nalinso zomwe zinandepanditsa kawiri ndi kawiri kubwera kwa inu.
Koma tsopano palibe malo akutsalira m'madera awa, ndilinso ndi chilakolako chachilendo kwa inu chakumbukirira chaka zambiri,
ndidzabwera kwa inu ndidzapita ku Spain. Chifukwa ndiyembekezera kukuonani nditadutsa, ndipo ndikutsanziridwani kutsogolera, ngati chitatu ndidzakondwera nawo.
Koma tsopano ndikupita ku Yerusalemu kutumikira oyera.
Pakuti Macedonia ndi Akaya anasangalala kuchita mgawano wina kwa osauka a oyera a Yerusalemu.
Anasangalala kuchita, ndipo anali ngongole kwa iwo. Pakuti ngati amitundu agawana m'zinthu za mzimu zawo, ndi ngongole kuzitumikira m'zinthu za thupi.
Chifukwa chake nditatha ichi ndi kusindikiza zipatso izi kwa iwo, ndidzadutsa kwa inu ku Spain.
Ndipo ndidziwa kuti nditabwera kwa inu ndidzabwera m'kuchuluka kwa dalitso la uthenga wabwino wa Khristu.
Ndikukupemphani, abale, kupyolera Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu ndi chikondi cha Mzimu, kuti mulimbane ndi ine m'mapemphero kwa Mulungu chifukwa changa,
kuti ndimasululike kwa osakhulupirira a Yudeya, ndi kuti utumiki wanga wa ku Yerusalemu ulandiriridwe ndi oyera,
kuti ndi chimwemwe ndidzabwera kwa inu ndi chifuniro cha Mulungu, ndizipumzitsa ndi inu.
Tsopano Mulungu wa mtendere akhale ndi inu nonse. Amen.
Ndikuunikireni Foibe mlongo wathu, wakhala mdiakoni wa mpingo ku Kenkreya.
Kuti mumulandiridwe mwa Ambuye mofanana ndi oyera, namuthandizeni m'chilichonse chimene angafune kwa inu, pakuti iye nawo anachitiranso athandizidwa ambiri, kuphatikizapo ine.
Munywaneni Priskila ndi Akwila ogwira ntchito ndi ine mwa Khristu Yesu,
amene anapereka miili yawo chifukwa cha moyo wanga, amene si ine woyamba ndi chiyamikiro kwa iwo, koma mipingo yonse ya amitundu nawo.
Ndipo munywaneni mpingo umene umagromba m'nyumba mwawo. Munywaneni Epineto wokondedwa wanga, amene anali zipatso za choyamba za Asia kwa Khristu.
Munywaneni Mariya, amene wagwira ntchito zambiri kwa inu.
Munywaneni Andronikosi ndi Yuniya, azibale anga, omwe anali m'ndende ndi ine, amene ali odziwika pakati pa atumwi, amene anali mwa Khristu asanandikale.
Munywaneni Ampliato wokondedwa wanga mwa Ambuye.
Munywaneni Urbano, ogwira ntchito nafe mwa Khristu, ndi Stakisi wokondedwa wanga.
Munywaneni Apele, wovomeredwa mwa Khristu. Munywaneni amene ali a nyumba ya Aristobulo.
Munywaneni Herodioni, mzibale wanga. Munywaneni amene ali mwa Ambuye a nyumba ya Narkiso.
Munywaneni Trifena ndi Trifosa, ogwira ntchito mwa Ambuye. Munywaneni Perisi wokondedwa, amene wagwira ntchito zambiri mwa Ambuye.
Munywaneni Rufo, wosankhidwa mwa Ambuye, ndi mayi wake ndi wanga.
Munywaneni Asinkirito, Flegoni, Herme, Patrobasi, Herma, ndi abale amene ali nawo.
Munywaneni Filologosi ndi Yulia, Nereya ndi mlongo wake, ndi Olimpasi, ndi oyera onse amene ali nawo.
Munywaneni wina ndi mnzake ndi phwapo loyera. Mipingo yonse ya Khristu ikupatsani moni.
Ndikukupemphani, abale, kuti muchenjere amene abweretsa zigawo ndi zinthu zogwetsha zotsutsana ndi phunziro limene munapunzirira; mupewe nawo.
Pakuti anthu ngati awa satumikira Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu, koma mimba yawo yekha; ndipo ndi mawu osamba ndi mtambo wabwino anyenga mitima ya osazindikira.
Pakuti kumvera kwanu kwadziwa kwa onse. Chifukwa chake ndisangalala pa inu; koma ndifuna mukhale anzeru ku chabwino, koma osaopsa ku choipa.
Ndipo Mulungu wa mtendere posachedwa adzaphwanya Satana pansi pa mapazi anu. Chisomo cha Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu chikhale ndi inu.
Timoteyo ogwira ntchito ndi ine, ndi Lusio ndi Yasoni ndi Sosipaterio azibale anga, akupatsani moni.
Ine Tertio amene ndinalelemba kalata ino mwa Ambuye ndikupatsani moni.
Gaiyo mphako wanga ndi wa mpingo wonse akupatsani moni. Erasto woyang'anira chuma cha mzinda akupatsani moni, ndi Kwarto mwini wanga.

Kwa iye amene ali ndi mphamvu kukukhazikitsani malinga ndi uthenga wabwino wanga ndi kulalalikira kwa Yesu Khristu, malinga ndi kuululurwa kwa chinsinsi chimene chinali chobisika kwa nthawi ndi nthawi,
koma tsopano chionetsereka, ndi kupyolera malemba a aneneri, malinga ndi lamulo la Mulungu wosatha, chodziwitsa kwa amitundu onse ku kumvera kwa chikhulupiriro,
kwa Mulungu yekhayekha wanzeru, kupyolera Yesu Khristu, ulemerero kwamuyaya. Amen.
